scopeNote: Four real South African electricity-generation assets. Coordinates are transcribed from primary public Eskom documents, then converted mathematically from DMS to decimal degrees. Coordinate roles and document dates are explicit: some are project/site locators rather than station centroids. No current capacity, output, outage or completion claims are included.
conversion: absolute decimal degrees = degrees + minutes/60 + seconds/3600; south latitudes are negative and east longitudes positive. Values rounded to 8 decimal places; decimal precision does not imply survey accuracy.

editorialNotes: These primary-source markers support general exploration, not navigation, engineering, security, property boundaries or current operational decisions.
Display each coordinateLabel in the entity details. Avoid calling every marker an exact station position, because the source points have different purposes.
No third-party coordinates were used. Do not replace a sourced point with a plausible-looking web-map coordinate without adding and checking a primary reference.
The 2017 combined Matimba/Medupi atmospheric report repeats identical coordinates for both stations. It was rejected as a source of separate station positions.
No current capacity/output or unit-operating-status claims were added. Sources may describe historic projects or stale construction states.
Do not copy operator diagrams, basemap imagery, photographs or long report excerpts into the product.
